hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: Hive Vault Arc is committed to protecting your personal data in compliance with Moroccan Law 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data (CNDP), as well as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applicable to residents of the European Union under its extraterritorial scope.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.intro: The data controller for personal data collected via hivevaultarc.com is:

collection.title: 2. Data We Collect
collection.intro: We collect only the data strictly necessary for the purposes described below:

items.label: Contact form
items.detail: name, email address, phone number (optional), company name (optional), industry (optional), team size (optional), and message.

items.label: Server logs
items.detail: IP address, browser type and version, pages visited, and request timestamps.

items.label: Analytics data
items.detail: anonymised page paths, referrers, device and browser categories, and coarse location data collected through Vercel Web Analytics. The service does not store IP addresses or use cookies to identify visitors.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes of Processing
purposes.intro: Your data is processed for the following purposes:
items: Responding to your contact requests and enquiries about our services.
Drafting and delivering commercial proposals and service agreements.
Improving website performance and user experience.
Complying with applicable legal and regulatory obligations.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.intro: Each processing activity rests on a legal basis compliant with Article 6 of the GDPR and Article 4 of Law 09-08:

items.label: Consent
items.detail: you voluntarily submit information through the contact form.

items.label: Performance of a contract
items.detail: processing necessary to fulfil an agreed service engagement.

items.label: Legitimate interest
items.detail: security logs and aggregated, cookieless analytics used to protect and improve the site.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.body: The public site does not currently use advertising or analytics cookies. Vercel Web Analytics measures page views with anonymised, aggregated data and does not place a cookie or retain a persistent identifier that follows a visitor across websites or days. If a future feature requires optional cookies, this policy and the consent controls will be updated before those cookies are enabled.

rows.period: According to the hosting provider’s security-log retention settings
5 years after the end of the commercial relationship
For the reporting window available under the active Vercel plan

sharing.title: 7. Data Sharing and Recipients
sharing.intro: We never sell your personal data. Authorised recipients are strictly limited to the technical sub-processors necessary to operate the site:

recipients.label: Vercel Inc.
recipients.detail: site hosting and deployment (Covina, California, United States).

sharing.closing: None of your data is shared with third parties for advertising or marketing purposes.

transfers.title: 8. International Data Transfers
transfers.body: Data hosted on Vercel servers in the United States involves a transfer outside the European Economic Area, governed by Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission under Article 46 of the GDPR. For transfers outside Morocco, Hive Vault Arc complies with Article 43 of Law 09-08 and applicable CNDP authorisations.

rights.title: 9. Your Rights
rights.intro: Under the GDPR (Articles 15–22) and Law 09-08, you have the following rights:

items.label: Right of access
items.detail: Obtain a copy of your data being processed.

items.label: Right to erasure
items.detail: Request deletion of your data, subject to applicable exceptions.

items.label: Right to restriction
items.detail: Temporarily suspend processing of your data.

items.label: Right to portability
items.detail: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.

items.label: Right to object
items.detail: Object to processing based on legitimate interest.

rights.exercisePrefix: To exercise your rights, send your request to
rights.exerciseSuffix: . We are committed to responding within 30 days.

authorities.title: 10. Supervisory Authorities
authorities.intro: If you believe the processing of your data infringes your rights, you may lodge a complaint with the competent authority:

items.name: CNDP
items.description: Commission Nationale de contrôle de la Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel

items.name: CNIL (France) or local DPA
items.description: The data protection authority of your country of residence

security.title: 11. Data Security
security.intro: Hive Vault Arc implements appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against loss, unauthorised access, disclosure, or accidental destruction:
items: Encryption of data in transit via HTTPS/TLS.
Strict access controls on systems holding personal data.
Regular review of user access rights.

automated.title: 12. Automated Decision-Making and Profiling
automated.body: hivevaultarc.com does not carry out fully automated decision-making or profiling within the meaning of Article 22 of the GDPR. No algorithm makes decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on you based on your data.

changes.title: 13. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: Hive Vault Arc may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in its practices or applicable legal obligations. In the event of a material change, a notice will be provided by email where appropriate or on the site. The “Last updated” date will be revised accordingly.

items.question: What does Hive Vault Arc do?
items.answer: Hive Vault Arc is a technology transformation partner combining strategy, AI engineering, software, cloud infrastructure, and managed operations. We advise, build, and operate so organizations can redesign how work happens and keep production systems improving after launch.

items.question: What is the ARC Program?
items.answer: The ARC Program is Hive Vault Arc’s structured engagement model: Assess the operating state and constraints, Re-engineer processes and systems, then Command the production operation through stabilization and continuous improvement.

items.question: Does Hive Vault Arc build WhatsApp AI agents?
items.answer: Yes. We build multilingual agents on the WhatsApp Business API for lead qualification, customer support, sales automation, persistent operational context, and direct CRM integration.

items.question: Is Hive Vault Arc an AI company, a consulting firm, or a software agency?
items.answer: Hive Vault Arc is a technology transformation partner. We combine strategy, AI engineering, software delivery, cloud infrastructure, and managed operations in one accountable team.

items.question: What kinds of AI solutions does Hive Vault Arc build?
items.answer: We build customer-facing AI agents, internal workflow automation, lead qualification and routing systems, decision-intelligence dashboards, and orchestration layers connecting AI with CRM, calendar, and data systems.

items.question: What does a digital transformation engagement look like?
items.answer: It begins with discovery of business goals, operating constraints, and existing systems. We then define the roadmap, architecture, and delivery scope before executing through clear milestones and remaining involved through deployment and stabilization.

items.question: Can Hive Vault Arc support us after the system is live?
items.answer: Yes. We provide reliability monitoring, optimization cycles, roadmap extensions, and architectural guidance as your operations evolve.

items.question: Do you publish real proof of delivery?
items.answer: Yes. We publish approved case studies with the business context, architecture decisions, integrations, deployment status, and only those outcomes that have been verified and cleared for publication.

items.question: Where is Hive Vault Arc based and what markets do you serve?
items.answer: We are based in Tangier, Morocco, and serve organizations in Morocco and international markets. Our team works in English, French, Arabic, and Spanish.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Commercial scope is defined after discovery and depends on transformation complexity, required systems, integrations, delivery responsibilities, and ongoing support needs.

items.question: What are Hive Vault Arc’s service pillars?
items.answer: Hive Vault Arc works across strategy and business consulting, technology consulting, AI and data, software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and operations and managed services. Each engagement combines the capabilities required by the operating problem.

items.answer: We deliver AI agents, workflow automation, decision intelligence, reporting systems, orchestration layers, and operational integrations connected to CRM and data platforms.

items.answer: Consulting includes strategy, architecture decisions, roadmap design, technology-function planning, and transformation sequencing, with accountability maintained through delivery.

items.answer: Our work includes AI agents, generative AI engineering, predictive analytics, data pipelines, warehouses, executive dashboards, and MLOps.

items.answer: Yes. Delivery can include cloud migration, infrastructure automation, zero-trust design, observability, identity controls, monitoring, and governance.

items.answer: Yes. We can remain responsible for managed operations, application maintenance, performance tuning, AI-system management, support, and ongoing optimization.
